items.a: Not only. Tempo Labs and Stripe co-author it: three of the five core authors work at Tempo Labs and two at Stripe. Rails such as Visa, Lightspark and Circle write their own payment methods.

No. The core is an individual Internet-Draft, draft-httpauth-payment-01 (2026-09-09), with no working group, stream or intended status. IANA has registered none of its header or scheme names as of 2026-10-11.

No. Besides stablecoin methods on Tempo and other chains, the stripe method carries Shared Payment Tokens for cards and wallets, the Visa-authored card method carries encrypted network tokens, and the lightning method pays BOLT11 invoices.

items.q: Is the MPP in AP2 documents the same thing?
items.a: No. In AP2, MPP abbreviates Merchant Payment Processor, a role in the payment flow. It has nothing to do with the Machine Payments Protocol.

items.q: Was the IETF draft renamed on 2026-09-09?
items.a: No. The new name draft-httpauth-payment first appeared as -00 on 2026-06-19; 2026-09-09 is its -01 revision. The old name, draft-ryan-httpauth-payment, expired on 2026-09-18.

items.q: Is session a standard MPP intent?
items.a: Not yet. Only charge and subscription are in specs/intents. Session is defined inside six method specs, and the pull request for a generic session intent closed unmerged on 2026-09-28, even though a June blog post called sessions a formal intent.

items.q: How is MPP different from x402?
items.a: MPP uses HTTP authentication headers (WWW-Authenticate, Authorization, Payment-Receipt) and lets the server or rail settle; x402 uses its own headers and a facilitator. MPP maps x402 exact to charge, and mppx can serve both on one route.

items.q: Can a leaked credential be used by someone else?
items.a: Yes, until it is used. Credentials are bearer tokens, so servers and intermediaries must never log them, and TLS 1.2 or later is required.

items.q: How much can an agent lose in a session?
items.a: At most the channel deposit, because vouchers cannot exceed it. On close the server may capture only what was spent and must refund the rest.

items.q: What if the server never closes my channel?
items.a: Call requestClose on chain, wait the grace period of at least 15 minutes (the spec advises 16), then call withdraw. The server can still settle its newest voucher during the grace period.

items.q: Does MPP support refunds and chargebacks?
items.a: It depends on the method. Card routes keep chargebacks; Stripe stablecoin payments have no disputes; on-chain charges are final unless the seller refunds.

Mastercard has not said so in its own words. In its 2026-06-10 Agent Pay for Machines release, Tempo says it is working with Mastercard on MPP compatibility. There is no Mastercard method spec; the Visa card method accepts mastercard as a network value.

items.q: Were Anthropic, OpenAI and Shopify MPP design partners?
items.a: No source says so. Tempo's launch post names them as partners for stablecoin use cases on Tempo; only Visa is called an MPP design partner.
